source_parameters.name: citation
source_parameters.value: En 1985-1986, les femmes vivant en couple assumaient 81 % des tâches les plus contraignantes du quotidien (ménage, cuisine, vaisselle, linge, etc.). Avec le temps, la part du travail réalisé par les femmes est en légère diminution, passant de 77 % en 1998 à 72 % en 2010. En 2010, les femmes vivant en couple et ayant au moins un enfant consacrent 34 heures hebdomadaires de travail domestique contre 18 heures pour les hommes dans même situation. Source : Insee et Ministère des familles, de l’enfance et des droits des femmes, Chiffres clés édition 2016

citations.translated_citation: In 1985–1986, women living with a partner performed 81% of the most demanding daily tasks (cleaning, cooking, washing dishes, laundry, etc.). Over time, the share of work performed by women declined slightly, from 77% in 1998 to 72% in 2010. In 2010, women living with a partner and having at least one child spent 34 hours per week on domestic work, compared with 18 hours for men in the same situation. Source: Insee and the Ministry of Families, Children and Women’s Rights, Chiffres clés, 2016 edition

citations.translated_citation: If women staged a revolution in this area, in the domestic sphere, if they refused it, if they forced men to do it with them... Moreover, it is clandestine work to which they are condemned. Because I find that living this life year after year, for a lifetime, without anything productive, really is a sentence. Well, if this changed, the whole of society would be transformed;
